OtherNames: Dakar LNG Terminal; ELTON Dakar import terminal
Pipelines: Two 15-km submarine gas pipelines (Port of Dakar to onshore power stations)
ResearcherNotesProject: Greenfield second LNG import terminal at Port of Dakar, distinct from existing Karmol Dakar FSRU (T100000131049). Developer ELTON Logistics and Services (subsidiary of Senegalese ELTON Oil Company). Reganosa appointed project management consultant (PMC) supervising detailed engineering/construction (technical advisor since Dec 2023; PMC contract early 2026). GasEntec contracted (signed 22 Apr 2026) to deliver a jetty-based LNG regasification unit + associated onshore equipment; modular regas-on-quay early-gas phase, full FSU concept ~137,000 cbm (some sources 150,000 cbm). Project structured in two phases. ELTON Oil signed gas-supply/offtake deal with Senelec. Supplies Cap des Biches 300 MW CCGT (Senegal's largest power plant) plus other power plants and industrial users, via two 15-km submarine pipelines + 10 truck-loading bays. Energy Intelligence frames it as Senegal's 'second LNG import project.' Target: first gas expedited, full terminal operations H1 2027. Capacity left blank (no published regas mtpa figure found). Status=construction given signed EPC contract + active PMC supervision of construction; could alternatively be staged 'proposed' (no FID/groundbreaking explicitly reported) - flagged for reviewer judgment.
